verdict.rationale: Shipping an official SDK is a fair question for a coding-agent product, since agent platforms can expose programmatic SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers the desktop app's model picker, BYO provider keys, MCP/skills client support, git workflows and install/update. The `pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev` command is a monorepo dev command for running the app, not a published SDK. No official SDK is evidenced.
